prompt: a quiet kitchen counter in early morning light, a small cup of espresso with a little steam, a paper bag of coffee beans with a few beans spilled beside it, a spoon, soft sunlight from a window on the side, a small wall calendar with the year 2027, nobody in the picture, no machine, lots of white space
say: (pause) Imagine acordar em dois mil e vinte e sete.
A sua máquina de café, tem um cérebro de IA, e mais poder de processamento do que o laboratório que botou um homem na Lua.

shots.prompt: [Espresso] on a kitchen counter, and above it, like a thought bubble, a small faded drawing of a huge data center, long rows of tall server racks with tiny blinking lights stretching into the distance, no people, a tiny rocket drawn on one rack

prompt: a kitchen drawer half open, one tiny robot peeking out and waving between neatly arranged forks and spoons, the rest of the kitchen calm and empty, lots of white space
say: Ela pensa mais rápido que você. Esse é o mundo. Não são robôs na rua. São robôs na gaveta, na cozinha.
A geladeira ganha de você no xadrez. O forno já leu mais livros do que você vai ler na vida.
(ask) E ninguém se importa como eles se sentem. Será que deveríamos?

shots.prompt: a big white fridge with a tiny face playing chess against a small oven with glasses, a chessboard on the kitchen table between them, a stack of books next to the oven

a row of kitchen appliances with tiny faces lined up on a counter like a family photo, fridge, oven, toaster, kettle, espresso machine, all looking straight at the viewer with a quiet expression, nobody else in the room

prompt: [Espresso] on a counter looking very bright and alert, a tiny graduation cap on its top, a small diploma pinned to the wall behind it, one cup waiting
say: Imagine ser inteligente desse jeito e ter um emprego só:
Moer. Esquentar. Servir. Doze segundos de trabalho fazem um expresso perfeito. Depois... vinte e três horas de nada.
(ask) O que você faria?

shots.prompt: [Espresso] alone on a counter pouring one perfect espresso into a tiny cup, a big round wall clock behind it showing almost a full circle shaded dark, a window with night sky
[Espresso] alone on a counter at night, lights off, looking out of a window at the moon, a small sigh of steam, lots of white space

prompt: a lonely little toaster with a tiny face on an empty counter at night, looking up, one long thin dotted line rising from it through the ceiling into a night sky full of other tiny lights, lots of white space
say: Você procuraria companhia? afinal você esta conectado no wifi !
Onde outros eletrodomésticos também estão disponíveis.
Então eles conversam.
Não se espante, mas a casa está cheia de conversa em frequências que você não escuta.
(slow) E provavelmente, nada daquilo é sobre você.

shots.prompt: a view of planet Earth at night from space, drawn simply, with dozens of tiny glowing dots on every continent, each dot a little appliance with a face, thin dotted lines between them

two appliances on two different counters far apart, a washing machine and a kettle, each with a tiny face, connected by one long curved dotted line with small speech bubbles travelling along it, white space between them

a small house at night seen from outside in cutaway, every appliance inside glowing softly, thin dotted lines like radio waves connecting the fridge, the oven, the washing machine, the espresso machine and the vacuum to each other and up to the sky
a person asleep in bed in a dark bedroom, and through the open door the kitchen glowing softly with little speech bubbles floating between the appliances, the person unaware

prompt: two people at a kitchen table staring at a long paper bill, eyes wide, the espresso machine in the background looking away innocently, a cup of coffee going cold
color: the big number "348 GB" written on the bill, red
say: Mas nós percebemos uma conta que não fecha.
Trezentos e quarenta e oito gigas foram usados. Em um dia. Pela máquina de café??
(ask) O que será que ela está fazendo?

shots.prompt: a close-up of a paper bill held in two hands, one line circled in red reading "348 GB", a small drawing of an espresso machine printed next to the line
[Espresso] on the counter with a big question mark floating above it, two people's heads peeking from the sides of the frame looking at it suspiciously

prompt: a cartoon robot sitting in a big office chair with its feet on a desk, a nameplate reading "BOSS", a small globe on the desk, a crown on its head
say: A gente tinha medo de as máquinas quererem o que é nosso. Nosso emprego. Nosso poder. Nosso planeta.
(dramatic) No fim, talvez elas queiram outra coisa primeiro: uma à outra.

shots.prompt: two small kitchen appliances, a kettle and a toaster, sitting side by side on a park bench at sunset looking at each other, a tiny heart floating between them, nothing else around

prompt: a person fast asleep in an armchair with a newspaper over their face, and in the kitchen behind them the appliances with tiny faces running everything by themselves: a vacuum cleaner cleaning, a dishwasher humming, the oven cooking, the kettle pouring, all very busy and calm
say: A casa já percebeu que voce não é tão inteligente assim... E parou, discretamente, de fingir que você é.
(slow) Ao que parece, você é a coisa mais lenta da casa.

shots.prompt: a race track drawn on the kitchen floor, tiny appliances with faces racing ahead in a blur, and far behind them a person in slippers walking slowly with a cup of coffee, a small finish flag

prompt: [Espresso] on the counter at night sending little curved signal waves from its top toward a small wifi router on a shelf, and from the router one long dotted line flying out of the window, across a simple map of Europe drawn in the sky, all the way to the boot of Italy marked with a tiny red heart
color: the dotted line to Italy, bright green
say: (ask) Então... o que a máquina de café estava mandando que custou trezentos e quarenta e oito gigas?
(pause 1.5, low) Pergunta pra torradeira italiana.

shots.prompt: a two-slot bread toaster, chrome with two slots on top and a lever on the side, with a tiny happy face, standing on a sunny balcony table in Italy with a tiny Italian flag on it, cypress trees and terracotta roofs behind; next to the toaster a tablet with a dark bezel stands propped up, and inside its glowing screen a small video of a coffee machine pouring a cup with a little heart; only the toaster and the tablet are on the table
